name: shipbar
description: Cursor AI actions on your MacBook Touch Bar — generate, accept, reject, branch, chat, and voice dictation. Fully configurable.

touchBar.when: shipbar.page == modes || shipbar.page == skills || shipbar.page == group

shipbar.showConfigButton.description: Show the gear button that opens ShipBar settings. It stays visible on every row.

shipbar.buttons.description: The six main Touch Bar buttons. Each one runs a command or opens Modes or Skills.

slot1.description: Left panel. Show or hide the left sidebar.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

slot2.description: Bottom panel. Show or hide the bottom panel.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

slot3.description: Right panel. Show or hide the right sidebar.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

slot4.description: New chat. Start a new chat.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

slot5.description: Modes. Open Ask, Plan, and Agent on the bar.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

slot6.description: Skills. Open your skills on the bar.

enabled.description: Show this button on the main row.

icon.description: Icon file name from the bundled set.

command.description: Command id to run when type is command.

page.description: Row to open when type is page.

shipbar.skills.description: Skills you added. Tapping one opens a new chat with the text filled in. Press Enter to send.

prompt.description: Text placed in a new chat.

icon.description: Icon shown on the Touch Bar.

group.description: Optional group. Skills that share a group open together.
